title: warium Chinese translation / warium中文翻译
description: This is an unofficial Simplified Chinese translation resource pack for the mod Warium.
body:
# **EN:**
Unofficial Simplified Chinese translation resource pack for [warium](https://modrinth.com/mod/warium).This resource pack provides full Simplified Chinese localization for the [warium](https://modrinth.com/mod/warium) mod.

Please contact me if you have any objections, and I will remove it promptly.
